motivation: 24B raw nuisance accuracy is dominated by positive-earlier chronology imbalance.
TG10 Ridge is the most stable astrology-only representation across collection waves.
ALL_ORTHODOX adds noise and ElasticNet selection is unstable.
Axis diagnostics suggest outcome-mechanism heterogeneity, but a production general score must not require knowing the future event axis.
metric_definition: Within each repeat, compute equal-subject-weight accuracy separately for positive-later and positive-earlier pairs, then average the two strata 50/50.
feature_universe: exact TG10 dynamic features only (40 pair-difference columns from 24B)

winner_eligible_models.name: TG10_SHARED_RIDGE_BALANCED
winner_eligible_models.description: One shared deployable TG10 coefficient vector.
winner_eligible_models.hyperparameter: C chosen by inner subject-CV on chronology-balanced metric

winner_eligible_models.name: TG10_MULTITASK_EFFECT_RIDGE_BALANCED
winner_eligible_models.description: Effect-coded axis deviations are allowed during training, but the deployable score uses only the common global TG10 coefficient vector. Axis is never required at inference.
winner_eligible_models.hyperparameter: C chosen by inner subject-CV using deployable global-score chronology-balanced metric

next_if_survivor: Freeze the deployable global TG10 architecture and coefficients, then benchmark against Production Control once with zero retuning.
next_if_none: Do not add another broad feature search. Revisit target/representation design on DEV or conclude current annual astrology primitives lack promotion-grade signal.
